cases.input: Demand carries requestMode=named-preference, names SPEC-1 via WM-PER-001, and still declares resourceClass, competence, quantityKind, unit and unitSchemeVersion.
cases.expect: Accepted as a non-binding preference. No exclusivity, no reservation, no assignment; matching still yields a scored candidacy.

cases.input: Demand references a WM-PER-001 person with no requestMode declared.
A named-preference demand is read as reserving that person's capacity.
Demand closure updates the referenced WM-PER-001 or WM-ORG-016 record.
Demand declares neither interval nor deadline.
Demand declares both an interval and a conflicting deadline with no precedence rule.
Demand asserts 100 GPU-hour with no unitSchemeVersion.
divisibility is omitted and the matcher treats the demand as divisible.
Two demands with priority 1 and priority high are ranked against each other with no named priority scheme.
Quantity rises from 100 to 140 GPU-hours.
cases.expect: A DemandVersion keyed [resourceDemandId, version] is created with contentDigest, validFrom and supersedesVersion; the prior version stays resolvable and unchanged.

cases.input: A released scenario pins the demand by resourceDemandId with no version.
Demand is approved while nothing can satisfy it.
cases.expect: approvalState=approved and fulfilmentState=open coexist; approval asserts nothing about supply.

cases.input: A scored candidacy assertion sets fulfilmentState=covered.
A demand with no deadline transitions to lapsed.
A confirmed allocation inside non-baseline scenario S1 advances fulfilmentState to covered.
S2 is selected as baseline by an authorized decision and its confirmed allocations cover the demanded quantity.
cases.expect: fulfilmentState advances with fulfilmentBasisRef pinning the scenario release and the decision; S1 has no effect on the root.

cases.input: Demand declares quantityKind=currency with amount 50000 EUR as a resource requirement.
100 GPU-hours is valued in currency using a pinned conversion factor with evidence.
cases.expect: A new, separately identified quantity is produced; the original demand quantity is unchanged and the two are never summed.

cases.input: Demand asserts 80 to 140 GPU-hours with a declared distribution.
cases.expect: The range is retained on the assertion and carried into planning without collapse.

cases.input: The 80 to 140 range is collapsed to its mean for a capacity check.
requestingWorkRef is populated with no declared target master.
An approved, partially covered demand is withdrawn.
cases.expect: Prior approvals, candidacies and scenario references remain resolvable; no external master is written.

cases.input: Approved demand is counted as available supply in a capacity figure.
